description: "Gate a channel wake, approval, or review comment on Jev by calling decide, then continuing or holding."
---

# Gating a GitHub write on Jev

Channel hooks can call `decide` before they start a model turn. Return
`null` when the answer misses the bar; return `{ auth }` or `{ task }`
when the agent should run.

This extension's `evaluate` tool does not write to GitHub. When an
approval or a review comment must follow the judgment, add a server tool
in this project that calls `decide`, then writes or holds in the same
`execute`.

```ts
import { above, decide, needsHuman } from "@grok/agent-sdk/extensions/jev";
```

Hold when `needsHuman` is true or `above` misses the bar. Very low and
low risk can approve; medium and above hold. A finding comment posts
only when the draft is a real bug. Calibrate those numbers on labeled
pull requests from this workflow. Pass the pull request title, summary,
and draft, not the checkout. Return without writing when
`ctx.session.purpose === "eval"`.
